project.objective: Identify the parents of Jonathan Barker (FamilySearch MHGK-WT7), born about 1819 in London, England, who resided in Jasper County, Mississippi in 1850 and Smith County, Mississippi from 1860 through 1880.
project.title: Jonathan Barker's parents

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: One-line preamble per skill invocation explaining what you're about to do. Assume basic GPS vocabulary. Define unusual or specialized terminology inline.

questions.question: Where and in what household was Jonathan Barker (born about 1819 in England) enumerated in the 1850 U.S. federal census of Jasper County, Mississippi?
questions.rationale: Every fact on Jonathan Barker's FamilySearch profile is unsourced compiled-tree data, so the premise (identity, age, English birth, Mississippi residence) must be verified before parentage can be pursued. The 1850 census is his earliest claimed record and the first U.S. census to name every household member with age and birthplace, making it the gatekeeper: it should confirm his age and birthplace and reveal a wife and children whose own records (marriage, later censuses, death records) can carry indirect evidence of his origins and parents. It also anchors the 1819–1850 migration gap for later immigration/naturalization searches.

items.rationale: United States Census, 1850 (FamilySearch, indexed with images) is the direct source the question asks about: it names every household member with age, sex, occupation and birthplace. Search 'Jonathan Barker', born ~1819 England, residence Jasper County; also try variants (Jno., John, Barkor/Barkers) since English-born heads are often mis-transcribed. Verify any hit against the original image and note the neighbors on the page for later FAN work.

items.jurisdiction: Smith, Jones, Wayne, Clarke, Newton and Scott Counties, Mississippi (neighbors of Jasper)
items.rationale: The 1850 Jasper residence comes from an unsourced tree and may be wrong, or the household may sit just across a county line (he is in neighboring Smith County by 1860). Widen the 1850 search to all adjoining counties and to statewide Mississippi with an England birthplace filter.

Ancestry's 1850 census index is an independent transcription; a name FamilySearch's index garbled may be readable there. Index searching is free; image viewing needs a subscription or a FamilySearch Center/library visit.

Jasper County tax rolls 1834-1896 survive as browse-only images in 'Mississippi, State Archives, Various Records, 1818-1952' (collection 1919687). Annual rolls place Jonathan Barker in the county around 1850, corroborate the census entry, and can narrow when he arrived. Most Jasper courthouse records start only in 1904-1906, so tax rolls are one of the few local sources left for this period.

The 1845 Mississippi state census returns for Jasper County (browse-only images in collection 1919687) list heads of household with tallies of household members. A Jonathan Barker entry would corroborate residence before 1850 and the size of his household.

Bridge record to confirm identity: the 1860 Smith County household (claimed on the tree) should list the same wife and the older children seen in 1850, with ages advanced 10 years. A matching household confirms the 1850 entry is the same man; it also helps if the 1850 entry is not found, since the children's ages and birthplaces show where the family lived in the 1840s.

log.notes: Searched statewide Mississippi to cover Jasper and neighbors at once. Strong single match: Household of Jonathan Barker, Jasper Co., MS, 1850 census, born ~1820 England (ark:/61903/1:1:M4L8-3ST), match score 0.72; attached to a different tree person (possible duplicate of MHGK-WT7). All other hits score <0.002 (SC-born John Barker in Marshall Co.; slave schedules; directories). Passed to record_read/extraction.

Broadened to 1860-1880 to cover the bridge census plus later life. Key hits: 1860 census Smith Co. household of Jonathan Barker b. ~1821 England (ark:/61903/1:1:M6GV-MG5); 1880 census Raleigh, Smith Co. 'John Barker' farmer b. ~1819 England (ark:/61903/1:1:M4P3-83T); 1866 MS state census Smith Co. 'Johnatha Barker' (ark:/61903/1:1:WDX9-3B3Z); several Confederate service-record entries for a Jonathan Barker (MS, 1862) and a Find a Grave Jonathan Barker d. 1863 Vicksburg (different man - our subject alive 1866-1880). Other hits are SC/KY/NC-born John Barkers.

Searched the indexed portion of 'Mississippi, State Archives, Various Records' (state censuses, tax rolls) statewide instead of browsing Jasper images. Found Jonathan Barker in the 1845 state census of SMITH County (ark:/61903/1:1:WD2C-XVN2) - not Jasper as planned - and 'Johnatha Barker' in the 1866 state census of Smith County (ark:/61903/1:1:WDX9-3B3Z). Index gives name/place/year only. No Jonathan Barker in Jasper County entries of this collection. Other hits are different John Barkers (Tippah, Jefferson, Tallahatchie, etc.).
